name: Telepathy
overview: The Bible clearly forbids seeking after familiar spirits, wizards, or any form of divination, warning that such practices defile and bring severe judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:27; Deuteronomy 18:10). Instead, Scripture calls believers to trust in God alone, praying to Him as our heavenly Father (Matthew 6:9) and avoiding deception or adding to His Word (Proverbs 30:6; Acts 5:3). Therefore, any pursuit of telepathy or similar occult practices stands in direct opposition to the holiness and truth revealed in God's Word.
